decision: DIFFERS -> HILL DEFAULT (spec §2.4; the crop's prose and UGA lead with hills). uga_c1206_homegrown_pumpkins: "Plant pumpkins in hills, with at least 8 feet of space on all sides." -> hill-none, hills [96,96] and rows [96,96] ('on all sides', spec §1.1), a MINIMUM authored as the point (W2: the sentence is a recommendation); "thin seedlings down to two to three plants per mound" -> plants_per_hill [2,3] (PLANTS after thinning). The row-none entry behind it is from the SAME page's table, "Spacing rows per plants 72 by 48 in." -> in_row [48,48], rows [72,72], so spacing_inches falls back to [48,48] (R2 as amended; today's [36,72] is a blend, on no page). Root row_spacing_inches = the hill's [96,96] (no see_layout). UMN's winter-squash sentence (24-36 in, rows 5-6 ft) is the alternative row entry; UGA's pumpkin-only table is preferred. Restatements: the two soil_prep hill figures '4 to 8 feet' -> 'at least 8 feet ... on all sides'.
